note: compare 成对呈现：两张真实宿主截图（docs/screenshots 内 chain 自仓库，浅色宿主拍摄）作为方案 A/B 对照，mode:side 并窄容器自动竖排。图片走 raw.githubusercontent 固定 commit，不需要鉴权。

items.content: 两张都是真实宿主里的截图：左边是入口网格，右边是指标面板。同一套组件，两种信息密度。

items.title: 入口网格 vs 指标面板

before.label: 方案 A · 入口网格
before.alt: 宿主面板中的模板中心：九张模板卡按三列排布
before.caption: 九张卡片一屏内看完，适合浏览与挑选。

after.label: 方案 B · 指标面板
after.alt: 宿主面板中的探索成就：三个指标、一条进度和三行成就条目
after.caption: 三个数字加一条进度条，适合回答“到哪一步了”。

items.title: 为什么并排而不是两张单图
items.content: 对照阅读时，两张图必须共享同一个阅读轴。compare 的 side / stack / slider 三种模式都在本地浏览，不发 action。
Both are real captures from a host panel: an entry grid on the left, a metrics panel on the right. Same components, two information densities.

before.label: Option A · entry grid
before.alt: A template centre inside a host panel: nine template cards in three columns
before.caption: Nine cards visible in one screen — built for browsing and picking.

after.label: Option B · metrics panel
after.alt: An achievement panel inside a host panel: three metrics, one progress bar and three rows
after.caption: Three figures and a progress bar — built to answer "how far along are we".

items.title: Why pair them instead of stacking two images
items.content: A comparison only works when both frames share one reading axis. The side / stack / slider modes all browse locally and send no action.
